notes_list.title: West Flowing River: Periyar
notes_list.basic_overview: Periyar (Kerala) flows west into the Arabian Sea. Krishna, Damodar and Ponnaiyar flow east.
notes_list.extra_info_content: Other well-known west-flowing rivers: Narmada, Tapi, Mahi, Sabarmati. Most peninsular rivers flow east into the Bay of Bengal.

notes_list.title: Lakes by Formation (8 types)
notes_list.basic_overview: Tectonic (Wular, Baikal); Oxbow (Kanwar - Bihar, Kabartal); Lagoon (Chilika - Odisha, Pulicat - AP/TN); Crater (Lonar - Maharashtra, Toba - Indonesia).
notes_list.extra_info_content: Glacial (Nainital, Bhimtal - Uttarakhand); Aeolian/wind-formed (Sambhar, Didwana - Rajasthan); Artificial (Govind Sagar - HP, Rana Pratap Sagar - Rajasthan); Landslide (Gohna - Uttarakhand). Some books classify Nainital, Bhimtal and Sambhar differently, so follow your exam source.
